name: Parnach
overview: Parnach is a male member of the tribe of Zebulun, noted in Scripture as the father of Elizaphan. His mention is brief and specific, highlighting his role within the genealogical context of the tribe. There are no additional personal details or notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Parnach is recorded as a proper name without an indicated meaning or divine origin. It appears simply as a personal identifier in the biblical text without further elaboration.
familyAndRelationships: Parnach is explicitly identified as a descendant of Zebulun and is the father of Elizaphan. Beyond these relationships, Scripture does not provide additional family connections for him.
scriptureSignificance: Parnach's significance lies primarily in his genealogical role within the tribe of Zebulun, serving as the father of Elizaphan. This connection situates him within the broader tribal structure important for understanding Israel's organization and inheritance as outlined in Numbers. His mention underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving the lineages of His people.
